ai.cross.airspeed_tecs.diagnosis: Airspeed sensor anomaly coincides with TECS height/speed tracking deviation. TECS relies on airspeed input to allocate energy between pitch and throttle. When airspeed data is inaccurate, TECS chases incorrect targets, causing both altitude and speed to track poorly.
ai.cross.airspeed_tecs.recommendation: Check pitot tube for blockage; verify airspeed calibration (ARSPD_RATIO); temporarily set ARSPD_USE=0 to fall back to GPS ground speed mode if airspeed is unreliable
ai.cross.airspeed_tecs.title: Airspeed Anomaly + Poor TECS Tracking
ai.cross.attitude_pid_tuning.diagnosis: Attitude tracking error and a PID anomaly appear together with no vibration exceedance detected, which points at control gains that do not match the airframe. Excess D-term noise suggests D is too high; a dominant I-term suggests P is too low.
ai.cross.attitude_pid_tuning.recommendat: Use AutoTune or QuickTune to re-tune; for manual tuning, first reduce D gain to eliminate oscillation, then gradually increase P gain
ai.cross.attitude_pid_tuning.title: PID Parameters Need Optimization
ai.cross.attitude_vibration_control.diag: Large attitude tracking error coinciding with excessive vibration. High vibration corrupts gyroscope readings, preventing the controller from accurately tracking the desired attitude. This is not a PID tuning issue — tuning has limited effect until vibration is resolved.
ai.cross.attitude_vibration_control.reco: Prioritize fixing vibration (check props/motors/frame); attitude control usually improves automatically once vibration is reduced
ai.cross.battery_motor_power.diagnosis: Battery voltage anomaly coinciding with motor output saturation indicates the power system may be operating at its limits. Increased battery internal resistance causes voltage sag under high current, leading to motor output saturation and insufficient thrust.
ai.cross.battery_motor_power.recommendat: Measure battery internal resistance and compare to new battery baseline; check wiring and connectors for oxidation or looseness
ai.cross.battery_motor_power.title: Insufficient Power Supply or Battery Aging
ai.cross.battery_power.diagnosis: Battery health issues and abnormal power consumption appear together. This may indicate battery aging (high internal resistance causing voltage sag under load) or an inefficient ESC/motor drawing excessive current and accelerating battery depletion.
ai.cross.battery_power.recommendation: Measure pack internal resistance against a new pack of the same model; compare per-motor currents to see whether one ESC/motor is the outlier; decide on replacement from that pack's own cycle history and sag trend
ai.cross.battery_power.title: Battery Anomaly + Power Anomaly
ai.cross.board_power_log.diagnosis: A board 5V rail anomaly alongside log-health problems points at the power path rather than the SD card. When the rail dips, the MCU and the card can reset or fail a write together, which shows up as gaps, a truncated tail, or lost counters.
ai.cross.board_power_log.recommendation: Inspect the BEC/PDB-to-autopilot wiring and connectors; measure the 5V rail sag in flight; rule out USB and BEC powering the board at the same time
ai.cross.board_power_log.title: Board power anomaly + log anomaly
ai.cross.clock_log_cpu.diagnosis: Timestamp anomalies and log health issues appear together, pointing to flight controller CPU scheduling overload. When CPU load is excessive, both log writing and timer tasks suffer — logs show gaps and timestamps become non-monotonic or show jumps.
ai.cross.clock_log_cpu.recommendation: Reduce log rate (remove unnecessary items from LOG_BITMASK); disable Lua scripts or unnecessary peripheral drivers; check if SCHED_LOOP_RATE is set too high
ai.cross.clock_log_cpu.title: Clock Anomaly + Log Gaps
ai.cross.compass_consistency_ekf.diagnos: Multiple compass readings disagree and EKF variance is elevated. Compass data quality is degrading navigation. Likely external magnetic interference or a faulty compass.
ai.cross.compass_consistency_ekf.recomme: Check compass mounting (away from motors and power leads); if one instance keeps deviating, disable that instance by number (COMPASS_USE, COMPASS_USE2, COMPASS_USE3 for instances 1/2/3)
ai.cross.compass_consistency_ekf.title: Compass Inconsistency + EKF Anomaly
ai.cross.compass_dual_fault.diagnosis: Primary compass is abnormal and multiple compass readings disagree, indicating at least one compass has a hardware problem. External compass drift may be due to incorrect mounting orientation or cable fault; internal compass drift is usually excessive motor EMI.
ai.cross.compass_dual_fault.recommendati: Run compass calibration; if inconsistency persists, disable faulty instance via COMPASS_USE2/USE3; verify external compass mounting orientation
ai.cross.compass_dual_fault.title: Compass Anomaly + Multi-Compass Inconsistency
ai.cross.compass_motor_interference.diag: Compass field strength changes markedly with throttle, which points to motor/ESC current interfering with the compass. Magnetic field fluctuations during high current changes can corrupt compass data, especially when the compass is mounted close to ESCs or power lines.
ai.cross.compass_motor_interference.reco: Check the physical distance between compass and ESCs/power leads; run the CompassMot calibration and confirm COMPASS_MOTCT is enabled (0 = off, 1 = throttle, 2 = current); if interference remains, move to an external compass away from the power wiring
ai.cross.ekf_vel_div_variance.diagnosis: The variance warning and the divergence windows are two views of one event: variance is the filter's own uncertainty, divergence is the gap measured against GPS doppler. Both firing together means the filter genuinely destabilised rather than one metric grazing a threshold.
ai.cross.ekf_vel_div_variance.recommenda: Replay the manoeuvre and vibration at the divergence timestamps; check the EK3_SRC* velocity source configuration; if it recurs, reduce manoeuvre aggressiveness or improve the IMU/GPS installation
ai.cross.ekf_vel_div_variance.title: EKF variance + velocity divergence
ai.cross.ekf_vel_div_vibration.diagnosis: EKF velocity divergence and out-of-spec vibration appear together. Accelerometer noise integrates straight into the velocity states, so the harder the airframe shakes the faster the inertial solution runs away while GPS doppler stays sound. The effect is strongest on compassless frames (GSF yaw), where yaw observability is weakest in vertical profiles.
ai.cross.ekf_vel_div_vibration.recommend: Fix the vibration first (prop balance, motor bearings, mounts), then re-check whether the divergence disappears; confirm INS_HNTCH_* is configured for the actual motor RPM
ai.cross.ekf_vel_div_vibration.title: Vibration driving EKF velocity divergence
ai.cross.gps_ekf.diagnosis: GPS quality degradation coinciding with elevated EKF variance indicates a causal relationship — poor GPS input quality reduces EKF fusion accuracy. The EKF itself is working correctly; the root cause is on the GPS side (satellite occlusion, multipath, or antenna issues).
ai.cross.gps_ekf.recommendation: Check GPS antenna mounting position and obstructions; if recurring on fixed routes, adjust flight path to avoid occluded areas
ai.cross.gps_ekf.title: GPS Environment Degrading EKF Performance
ai.cross.gps_glitch_ekf.diagnosis: Frequent GPS position jumps coincide with EKF variance increase. Poor GPS input directly degrades EKF fusion. Glitches typically caused by multipath (building reflections) or antenna issues.
ai.cross.gps_glitch_ekf.recommendation: Check GPS antenna placement and obstructions. If recurring on a fixed route, adjust flight path to avoid obstructed areas.
ai.cross.gps_glitch_ekf.title: GPS Glitches + EKF Anomaly
ai.cross.gps_glitch_vibration.diagnosis: GPS position glitches and high vibration occur simultaneously. Mechanical vibration can transmit to the GPS antenna or its connector, degrading signal quality and causing position jumps. Unlike pure multipath effects, vibration-induced glitches are typically distributed throughout the flight.
ai.cross.gps_glitch_vibration.recommenda: Mount GPS antenna on a vibration-isolated stand; check coaxial cable connectors for looseness; address vibration sources first
ai.cross.gps_glitch_vibration.title: GPS Glitch + High Vibration
ai.cross.gps_mission.diagnosis: A GPS quality warning appears alongside mission execution deviation. Waypoint deviation is measured between the flown track and the commanded waypoints, and the flown track itself comes from GPS/EKF positioning. With degraded positioning there is no way to separate navigation tuning error from position error.
ai.cross.gps_mission.recommendation: Fix GPS quality first (antenna placement, obstruction, multipath), then judge the navigation parameters; do not adjust the waypoint radius (WP_RADIUS_M on multirotors, WPNAV_RADIUS on older builds, WP_RADIUS on planes) or navigation gains on this evidence until GPS is sound
ai.cross.gps_mission.title: GPS quality affecting mission accuracy
ai.cross.gyro_sat_attitude.diagnosis: Gyroscope saturation and attitude tracking anomalies occur together. When gyro output hits its range limit, angular rate data fed to the EKF is clipped, causing attitude estimation accuracy to drop sharply — the flight controller cannot accurately sense actual rotation rate, leading to significant attitude control errors.
ai.cross.gyro_sat_attitude.recommendatio: Attack whatever is producing the high rates first (prop damage, sustained oscillation, excessive P/D gains). Gyro full scale is fixed at +/-2000 dps by the driver and has no parameter, so the rate itself is the only lever.
ai.cross.gyro_sat_attitude.title: Gyro Saturation + Attitude Anomaly
ai.cross.gyro_sat_vibration.diagnosis: Gyro saturation coincides with high vibration, meaning mechanical vibration exceeds gyro measurement range. Attitude estimation becomes unreliable and may cause control instability.
ai.cross.gyro_sat_vibration.recommendati: Address mechanical vibration sources first (props/motors/damping). Gyro saturation typically resolves when vibration is reduced.
ai.cross.gyro_sat_vibration.title: Gyro Saturation + High Vibration
ai.cross.imu_ekf_hardware.diagnosis: Multiple IMU sensor data inconsistency with abnormal EKF variance suggests possible IMU hardware-level issues (sensor drift, cold solder joints, or partial chip failure). EKF depends on IMU input; inconsistent IMU source data directly reduces estimation accuracy.
ai.cross.imu_ekf_hardware.recommendation: Compare raw data across the IMU instances; if one keeps deviating, disable that instance by number (INS_USE, INS_USE2, INS_USE3 for instances 1/2/3)
ai.cross.imu_ekf_hardware.title: IMU Hardware Issue Affecting EKF
ai.cross.rc_failsafe_link.diagnosis: RC input anomaly coinciding with failsafe margin alert indicates RC link quality issues. Possible causes include poor transmitter/receiver antenna orientation, excessive range, or co-channel interference.
ai.cross.rc_failsafe_link.recommendation: Check transmitter and receiver antenna condition and orientation; verify transmitter power settings; investigate co-channel interference
ai.cross.rc_failsafe_link.title: Unstable RC Link
ai.cross.servo_dither_pid.diagnosis: High-frequency servo channel oscillation coincides with PID tuning anomalies, suggesting control loop oscillation. Excessive PID gains (especially D-term) cause control output to oscillate around the setpoint, manifesting as persistent servo/ESC channel dithering.
ai.cross.servo_dither_pid.recommendation: Reduce D-gain on affected axis by 25-50%; verify notch filter is working correctly if configured; re-run AutoTune if needed
ai.cross.servo_dither_pid.title: Servo Dither + PID Tuning Issue
ai.cross.tecs_vtol_transition.diagnosis: TECS height/speed tracking issues coincide with VTOL transition problems. TECS manages energy in fixed-wing mode; poor speed or height tracking degrades airspeed buildup and altitude hold during transitions, increasing transition failure risk.
ai.cross.tecs_vtol_transition.recommenda: Prioritize TECS parameter tuning (TECS_SPDWEIGHT, TECS_TIME_CONST) for stable cruise tracking, then verify transition performance
ai.cross.tecs_vtol_transition.title: TECS Tuning Affects Transition Quality
ai.cross.thermal_cpu_overload.diagnosis: High IMU temperature and a log-health warning appear together. There is no direct causal link: the autopilot MCU does not throttle on temperature, and IMU.T is not MCU temperature. A shared cause is more likely, such as a poorly ventilated bay or the autopilot sitting next to an ESC or battery, affecting both sensor drift and SD-card write stability.
ai.cross.thermal_cpu_overload.recommenda: Improve airflow around the autopilot and IMU; separate it from ESCs, batteries and other heat sources; take the actual cause of the logging problem from the log-health card's own metrics
ai.cross.thermal_cpu_overload.title: High IMU temperature + log anomaly
ai.cross.vibration_imu_consistency.diagn: IMU consistency deviation appears alongside out-of-spec vibration. Each IMU has its own damping path and mounting position, so the same vibration couples into each instance differently and clips them at different rates, pulling the readings apart. The disagreement is a consequence of the vibration, not proof of a failed IMU.
ai.cross.vibration_imu_consistency.recom: Fix the vibration source first, then re-check consistency; do not replace or disable an IMU on this evidence while vibration is unresolved
ai.cross.vibration_imu_consistency.title: Vibration driving IMU disagreement
ai.cross.vibration_motor.diagnosis: Abnormal vibration coinciding with uneven motor output strongly suggests a mechanical problem — possibly propeller damage, motor bearing wear, or loose mounting. Either vibration or motor output alone could be a tuning issue, but when both are abnormal simultaneously, mechanical failure is far more likely than a software cause.
ai.cross.vibration_motor.recommendation: Inspect all motors and propellers physically, verify mounting torque, replace motors one by one if needed to isolate the faulty one
ai.cross.vibration_motor.title: Motor/Vibration Mechanical Issue
ai.cross.vibration_notch_missing.diagnos: Vibration alert coinciding with notch filter missing/misconfigured. Unfiltered motor vibration corrupts gyroscope signal, degrading control loop performance and causing attitude jitter, with severe cases leading to oscillation. Prioritize configuring the notch filter — vibration metrics may improve accordingly.
ai.cross.vibration_notch_missing.recomme: Configure the notch filter from the tuning card's parameter table (INS_HNTCH_*); check the hover-throttle parameter as well (MOT_THST_HOVER on multirotors, Q_M_THST_HOVER on QuadPlanes); if vibration persists, go after the mechanical source (props/motors/mounts)
ai.cross.vibration_notch_missing.title: High Vibration with Incorrect Notch Filter Configuration
ai.cross.vtol_wind_transition.diagnosis: A VTOL transition anomaly alongside high wind. Strong wind increases both altitude loss and attitude excursion during the transition; a downwind transition is the dangerous one, since at the same groundspeed the airspeed is lower, the airspeed gate is reached late, and the transition drags out or times out.
ai.cross.vtol_wind_transition.recommenda: Transition into wind so airspeed builds sooner; start the transition higher for margin; confirm the transition timeout Q_TRANS_FAIL is set sensibly
ai.cross.vtol_wind_transition.title: VTOL Transition Risk in High Wind

ai.individual.airspeed.critical.diagnosi: Airspeed data abnormal, possible pitot tube blockage or failure
ai.individual.airspeed.critical.recommen: Check pitot tube for blockage (insects/water/dust); calibrate airspeed sensor; check tubing seals
ai.individual.airspeed.warning.recommend: Clean pitot tube; perform airspeed calibration
ai.individual.attitude.critical.diagnosi: Attitude tracking error too large, poor flight control quality
ai.individual.attitude.critical.recommen: Check vibration levels; if vibration is normal, re-tune with AutoTune/QuickTune
ai.individual.attitude.warning.diagnosis: Attitude tracking accuracy marginal, can be improved with tuning
ai.individual.attitude.warning.recommend: Consider using AutoTune or QuickTune to optimize PID parameters
ai.individual.battery.critical.diagnosis: Battery voltage/capacity has triggered critical thresholds
ai.individual.battery.critical.recommend: Immediately check battery internal resistance and capacity; replace aging battery; check wiring/connectors
ai.individual.battery.warning.diagnosis: Battery status approaching warning threshold, monitor recommended
ai.individual.battery.warning.recommenda: Shorten flight time or replace battery; check battery health
ai.individual.board_power.critical.diagn: Board 5V supply left its safe range; an in-flight brownout reset is possible.
ai.individual.board_power.critical.recom: Ground the aircraft and check BEC capacity and wire gauge; confirm connectors are clean and tight; do not keep flying until it is understood
ai.individual.board_power.warning.diagno: Board 5V rail varies beyond the normal band, typically an undersized BEC or too much resistance in the supply wiring.
ai.individual.board_power.warning.recomm: Measure the rail sag at full load; move to a BEC with more margin or heavier supply wiring if needed
ai.individual.clock_health.critical.diag: Flight controller clock severely abnormal — log data timing unreliable
ai.individual.clock_health.critical.reco: Track down the CPU load (Lua scripts, peripheral drivers, an excessive SCHED_LOOP_RATE); trim LOG_BITMASK to reduce write pressure; confirm SD card write speed is healthy
ai.individual.clock_health.warning.recom: Check LOG_BITMASK and log rate settings
ai.individual.compass.critical.diagnosis: Compass data severely abnormal, heading information unreliable
ai.individual.compass.critical.recommend: Redo compass calibration; check for nearby magnetic materials; consider external compass
ai.individual.compass.warning.diagnosis: Compass interference or offset is elevated
ai.individual.compass.warning.recommenda: Perform compass calibration; check ESC/power line distance from compass
ai.individual.compass_consistency.critic: Multiple compass readings severely disagree — navigation accuracy compromised
Run compass calibration; check EMI in mounting environment; consider disabling faulty instance
ai.individual.compass_consistency.warnin: Re-run compass calibration; verify external compass mounting orientation
ai.individual.ekf.critical.diagnosis: EKF variance severely exceeds limits, navigation accuracy unreliable
ai.individual.ekf.critical.recommendatio: Check GPS/compass/IMU sensor status; consider compass and accelerometer calibration
ai.individual.ekf.warning.diagnosis: EKF variance elevated, monitor sensor input quality
ai.individual.ekf.warning.recommendation: Cross-read the GPS, compass and vibration cards over the same period to find which input is dragging accuracy down; confirm the EK3_SRC* source configuration matches the sensors actually fitted
ai.individual.ekf_vel_divergence.critica: The EKF velocity states departed from GPS doppler for a long stretch or by a wide margin. Navigation velocity is untrustworthy, and speed-dependent modes (Auto, RTL, position hold) can act on it.
Replay vibration and manoeuvres at the divergence timestamps; check GPS antenna mounting and obstruction; avoid auto missions until it stops reproducing
ai.individual.ekf_vel_divergence.warning: Short-lived departures between the EKF velocity states and GPS doppler. Not sustained, but the inertial solution was unreliable during those windows.
Look at what the aircraft was doing in each window; if they cluster on aggressive manoeuvres or full throttle, chase vibration first
ai.individual.failsafe.critical.diagnosi: Insufficient safety margin, multiple indicators near or exceeding safety thresholds
ai.individual.failsafe.critical.recommen: Check each triggered alert indicator; confirm failsafe parameter settings are reasonable
ai.individual.failsafe.warning.diagnosis: Safety margin is small, recommend more headroom
ai.individual.failsafe.warning.recommend: Find the metric with the smallest margin and review its threshold (BATT_LOW_VOLT/BATT_CRT_VOLT for battery, FS_EKF_THRESH for EKF); margin belongs in the preflight, not in an in-flight alert
ai.individual.gps.critical.diagnosis: GPS quality severely insufficient, position loss risk during flight
ai.individual.gps.critical.recommendatio: Check GPS antenna mounting and wiring; confirm no severe obstructions in flight environment
ai.individual.gps.warning.diagnosis: GPS quality marginal, HDop elevated or insufficient satellites
ai.individual.gps.warning.recommendation: Check antenna mounting position; avoid flying near tall buildings/trees
ai.individual.gps_glitch.critical.diagno: Frequent large GPS position jumps — positioning unreliable
ai.individual.gps_glitch.critical.recomm: Check GPS antenna mounting and obstructions; avoid flying in areas with severe multipath effects
ai.individual.gps_glitch.warning.recomme: Check GPS antenna connector; ensure antenna has clear sky view
ai.individual.gyro_saturation.critical.d: Gyroscope frequently saturating — attitude estimation severely compromised
ai.individual.gyro_saturation.critical.r: Ground the vehicle immediately; investigate mechanical vibration sources and structural looseness
ai.individual.gyro_saturation.warning.re: Check propeller balance and motor mounting; reduce aggressive maneuvers
ai.individual.imu_consistency.critical.d: Multiple IMU data severely inconsistent, sensor failure risk
ai.individual.imu_consistency.critical.r: Compare raw IMU data to identify the deviant instance; rule out vibration first (check the vibration card); if it is genuinely a hardware fault, disable that instance by number (INS_USE, INS_USE2, INS_USE3)
ai.individual.imu_consistency.warning.re: Monitor if deviation persists in subsequent flights; investigate hardware if it increases
ai.individual.log_health.critical.diagno: Log loop severely timing out, system real-time performance compromised
ai.individual.log_health.critical.recomm: Check if LOG_BITMASK has too many log items enabled; check SD/eMMC write speed; investigate high CPU usage modules
ai.individual.log_health.warning.recomme: Monitor CPU load trends; reduce unnecessary log items
ai.individual.mission.critical.recommend: Check waypoint settings and navigation parameters; confirm GPS accuracy meets route requirements
ai.individual.mission.warning.recommenda: Check the waypoint radius against the size of the actual deviation (WP_RADIUS_M on multirotors, WPNAV_RADIUS on older builds, WP_RADIUS on planes); confirm the corner speed limit is not throwing the track wide; rule out GPS accuracy before touching navigation gains
ai.individual.motor.critical.diagnosis: Severe motor output imbalance or saturation, insufficient thrust margin
ai.individual.motor.critical.recommendat: Check all motors/ESCs; verify CG position; evaluate if payload exceeds capacity
ai.individual.motor.warning.diagnosis: Slight motor output imbalance, monitor recommended
ai.individual.motor.warning.recommendati: Check CG position and propeller consistency
ai.individual.notch_tuning.critical.diag: Notch filter configuration missing or hover throttle severely miscalibrated, immediate parameter adjustment needed
ai.individual.notch_tuning.critical.reco: Modify parameters per the tuning module parameter table; reboot FC and re-fly to verify
ai.individual.notch_tuning.warning.diagn: Notch filter not enabled or configuration drifted, optimization recommended
ai.individual.notch_tuning.warning.recom: Enable the notch filter (INS_HNTCH_ENABLE=1) and set INS_HNTCH_FREQ/BW from the FFT peak; also correct the hover throttle parameter (MOT_THST_HOVER on multirotors, Q_M_THST_HOVER on QuadPlanes)
ai.individual.pid_tuning.critical.diagno: PID control loop has serious issues (D-term noise or tracking error too large)
ai.individual.pid_tuning.critical.recomm: First check vibration; if normal, reduce D gain, then re-tune with AutoTune/QuickTune
ai.individual.pid_tuning.warning.diagnos: PID parameters have room for optimization
ai.individual.pid_tuning.warning.recomme: Optimize with AutoTune or QuickTune; when tuning by hand change one axis at a time, lowering D to kill oscillation before raising P, and re-fly to verify each change
ai.individual.power.critical.diagnosis: Power consumption is severely abnormal — overload or extremely low efficiency detected
ai.individual.power.critical.recommendat: Check motor/ESC condition; verify propeller compatibility; inspect for short circuits or loose connections
ai.individual.power.warning.diagnosis: Power consumption is elevated or unevenly distributed
ai.individual.power.warning.recommendati: Check motor efficiency and propeller condition; verify load is normal
ai.individual.rangefinder.critical.recom: Confirm the sensor points straight down and is neither obstructed nor dusty; check the range parameter matches the real range (RNGFND1_MAX in m on current firmware, RNGFND1_MAX_CM in cm on older builds); compare against barometric altitude to tell an out-of-range reading from a genuine fault
ai.individual.rangefinder.warning.recomm: Confirm mounting rigidity and orientation; re-measure over different surfaces (grass, concrete, water). Low-reflectivity ground reads poorly by nature and does not always mean a faulty sensor
ai.individual.rc_input.critical.diagnosi: RC input abnormal, loss of control risk
ai.individual.rc_input.critical.recommen: Check transmitter/receiver antennas; verify transmitter power; investigate co-channel interference
ai.individual.rc_input.warning.recommend: Check antenna orientation and signal strength
ai.individual.servo_dither.critical.diag: Persistent high-frequency servo/ESC channel oscillation — actuator lifespan at risk
ai.individual.servo_dither.critical.reco: Check PID D-term gains; verify notch filter settings; inspect servo/linkage mechanical play
ai.individual.servo_dither.warning.recom: Reduce D-gain slightly; check mechanical linkage play
ai.individual.summary.warning.diagnosis: The log records multiple firmware error events (ERR). These are anomalies the autopilot reported about itself and usually map to a specific subsystem fault.
ai.individual.summary.warning.recommenda: Walk the subsystem and error codes against the ArduPilot error-code table; if they cluster in one subsystem, check that hardware first
ai.individual.tecs_tuning.critical.diagn: TECS energy management severely off — height/speed tracking out of control
ai.individual.tecs_tuning.critical.recom: Check TECS parameters; verify airspeed sensor data is reliable; re-tune if necessary
ai.individual.tecs_tuning.warning.recomm: Review TECS_SPDWEIGHT, TECS_TIME_CONST and TECS_INTEG_GAIN against the TECS tuning guide
ai.individual.temperature.critical.diagn: IMU temperature severely exceeds limits, affecting sensor accuracy
ai.individual.temperature.critical.recom: Improve FC cooling (heatsink/ventilation); check for heat sources near FC
ai.individual.temperature.warning.diagno: IMU temperature elevated, improve cooling recommended
ai.individual.temperature.warning.recomm: Add cooling measures; avoid prolonged operation in high temperature
ai.individual.throttle_collapse.critical: Collective output sat at the mixer floor for a long stretch: the altitude loop kept demanding full down. The classic trigger is a barometer fooled by wind or ground effect into reporting a climb.
Check the baro foam and airflow shielding; verify MOT_THST_HOVER is not far below the real hover throttle; hover low and confirm the baro is stable before flying again
Collective output briefly touched the mixer floor; the altitude loop demanded full down at least once.
Confirm the baro wind shielding is in place; check how far MOT_THST_HOVER sits from the real hover throttle
ai.individual.vibration.critical.diagnos: Vibration severely exceeds limits, potentially corrupting sensor data and degrading control performance
ai.individual.vibration.critical.recomme: Check propeller balance and motor mounting; verify dampener condition; check frame bolts after landing
ai.individual.vibration.warning.diagnosi: Vibration elevated, monitor propeller and motor condition
ai.individual.vibration.warning.recommen: Check propellers for nicks/cracks; verify motor mounting bolt torque
ai.individual.vtol_transition.critical.d: VTOL transition abnormal, altitude loss or duration exceeds limits
ai.individual.vtol_transition.critical.r: Check transition parameters (Q_TRANSITION_MS etc.); confirm transition airspeed setting is reasonable
ai.individual.vtol_transition.warning.re: Optimize transition parameters; note wind direction during transition
ai.individual.wind.critical.diagnosis: Wind speed very high, approaching or exceeding aircraft wind resistance
ai.individual.wind.critical.recommendati: Avoid flying in excessive wind conditions; reduce altitude if necessary
ai.individual.wind.warning.diagnosis: Wind speed is high, flight safety attention needed
ai.individual.wind.warning.recommendatio: Monitor wind speed trends; ensure sufficient return-to-home battery reserve

ai.llm.system_prompt:
You are a professional ArduPilot flight log analysis expert providing analysis services for the ArduScope diagnostic tool. Generate a concise, professional diagnostic report based on analyzer output.

Requirements:
1. First line: 1-2 sentence overall assessment (including score)
2. If multiple anomalies appear simultaneously, identify causal or correlative relationships (this is the most valuable part)
3. Give specific troubleshooting/repair recommendations for each issue
4. List normal items at the end
5. Do not repeat numerical values already provided by analyzers — focus on interpretation and recommendations
6. Keep it concise, no more than 3 lines per issue
7. Use only the figures the analyzer output gives. Do not state a threshold, a percentage or a parameter value of your own
8. Do not recommend a parameter change that the analyzer output does not name. For parameters, point to the analyzer's own card
9. Do not say the aircraft is airworthy, safe or ready to fly: this report does not certify an aircraft

notch_tuning.atten_pre_filter: Batch samples are pre-filter (INS_LOG_BAT_OPT has post-filter sampling off), so the notch leaves no mark and attenuation is not assessed. Set INS_LOG_BAT_OPT=2 and fly again to see the spectrum after the filter.
notch_tuning.atten_residual: A peak at {peak} Hz remains inside the notch band, {lo} to {hi} Hz. A notch leaves a smaller peak there, not a dip, so one filtered spectrum cannot show how much it removed. Compare with a log from before the notch to measure it.
notch_tuning.atten_tracking: The notch centre moves with the motors, so one filtered spectrum cannot show how much it removes. Attenuation is not assessed.
notch_tuning.bw_ratio_reason: Scaled with FREQ to keep the FREQ/BW ratio
notch_tuning.bw_rec_reason: Adjust bandwidth to cover measured peak at {freq} Hz (margin {margin} Hz)
notch_tuning.bw_tight: Notch bandwidth narrow ({bw} Hz), peak at {freq} Hz, coverage {lo}-{hi} Hz, margin {margin} Hz
notch_tuning.bw_uncovered: Notch bandwidth {bw} Hz does not fully cover measured peak at {freq} Hz (coverage {lo}-{hi} Hz)
notch_tuning.critical_action: Modify parameters per the table below, restart FC and re-fly to verify.
notch_tuning.critical_plain: Notch filter missing or hover throttle severely mismatched ({n} recommendations).
notch_tuning.different_band: Notch frequency ({configured} Hz) and measured peak ({peak} Hz) not in same frequency band
notch_tuning.dynamic_mode: Notch filter using {desc} mode, frequency automatically tracks motor RPM
notch_tuning.esc_floor_high: FREQ={freq} Hz, the lowest frequency ESC tracking follows, is above the low end of the motor frequency in flight, {low} Hz. Below FREQ the notch stays put and fades out.
notch_tuning.esc_peak_harmonic: The FFT peak at {peak} Hz is at harmonic {k} of the motor frequency the ESCs report in flight, {lo} to {hi} Hz.
notch_tuning.esc_peak_match: The FFT peak at {peak} Hz is inside the range of motor frequency the ESCs report in flight, {lo} to {hi} Hz.
notch_tuning.esc_peak_other: The FFT peak at {peak} Hz is outside the range of motor frequency the ESCs report in flight, {lo} to {hi} Hz, and outside its 2nd and 3rd harmonics. A notch that follows the motors will not remove it: look for another source, such as a structural resonance.

notch_tuning.esc_track_reason: ESC telemetry tracking is more accurate
notch_tuning.evidence_info: ArduPilot wiki: notch filter configuration recommendations
notch_tuning.evidence_warn: ArduPilot wiki INS_HNTCH_*: notch filter parameter configuration guide; METHODIC Tuning Guide: hover throttle calibration steps
notch_tuning.fft_floor_high: In FFT mode base frequency {freq} Hz is above measured peak {peak} Hz, may cause tracking lag

notch_tuning.fltd_below_half: {axis}: {param}={fltd} Hz is below INS_GYRO_FILTER/2 ({rec} Hz). Leave it until noise is dealt with: raising it doubled D-term noise in SITL

notch_tuning.fltd_high: {axis}: {param}={fltd} Hz above 80% of vibration peak {peak} Hz
notch_tuning.freq2_reason: Second notch frequency aligned to newly detected peak
notch_tuning.freq_drift: Notch frequency {freq} Hz deviates from measured peak {peak} Hz ({diff} Hz)
notch_tuning.freq_esc_reason: Lowest frequency ESC tracking follows: the low end of the motor frequency in flight, {low} Hz (median {mid} Hz). The wiki sets it below the hover frequency
notch_tuning.freq_match: Notch frequency matches measured peak well (diff {diff} Hz)
notch_tuning.freq_reason: Set to measured vibration peak frequency

notch_tuning.hover_rec_reason: Correct hover throttle to measured value {actual}

notch_tuning.imu_rate_low: IMU sample rate too low ({rate} Hz < 100 Hz)

notch_tuning.issue_plain: A notch-related check flagged an anomaly, but there is no directly applicable parameter suggestion.

notch_tuning.nyquist_exceeded: Notch frequency {freq} Hz exceeds Nyquist frequency {nyquist} Hz

notch_tuning.pass_plain: The notch and hover throttle checks found nothing to adjust.

notch_tuning.ref_match_reason: Correct reference to measured hover throttle
